candidates.change_summary: Replace transfer to Owner with sending zero value (no transfer) by transferring 0 wei instead of contract balance.
Replace transfer to Owner with sending to msg.sender instead of Owner.
Invert require to forbid the original Owner from calling withdraw (require msg.sender != Owner), changing who can withdraw.
Change transfer to use send and ignore its boolean result (using send instead of transfer alters failure behavior).
Change transfer to call with empty data and no value (low-level call) without checking success, altering behavior on failure and gas forwarding.
Replace the low-level call with a checked call that reverts on failure by requiring the call returns true, changing observable behavior when the call fails.
Change transfer amount to send only the current balance (omit adding msg.value) so payable(adr).transfer(address(this).balance);
Require strictly greater msg.value than current balance (change >= to >) so condition tighter and affects whether transfer runs
Remove the require line to allow transfer even if addition overflow check would have prevented it (though in 0.8.0 it reverts on overflow); this changes when transfer occurs
Invert the if condition so transfer runs when msg.value < address(this).balance instead of >=, altering when transfer executes
Move the require to before the if so the require always executes and can revert before checking the condition, changing observable behavior
